lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is the San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Tuesday, where they'll consider changing the AMI limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park — a technical-sounding move that directly shapes who can qualify for workforce housing in the county. The county Planning Commission also takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal on Wednesday, and Ridgway's council is ratifying letters backing a federal disaster declaration for the Gold Mountain Fire, which has scorched nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550.
